All work is complete. Final summary of what was built in `/workspace/submission`:

**Replay engine (`te/session.py`, `main.py`)** — whole-request validation first, then a per-case replay of the transport registry (tickets, issue-order sequences, receipts, checkpoints), immutable issue snapshots, the generation counter, and all eight event ops with their exact response schemas.

**Worker (`.../distributed/worker.py`, `active_set.py`, `pgd.py`, `simplex_projection.py`, `sparse_ops.py`)** — each captured problem is solved as a small bound+equality QP (`admit` via zero-cost slacks), with an exact primal active-set method (iterative refinement) whose equality multipliers *are* the certified potentials, plus a projected-gradient warm-start fallback. Potentials are chosen to minimize the certified gap `f−D`, exact zeros are enforced on unavailable/zero-demand slots and withdrawn edges, and infeasible `route` proposals list every owned unroutable global ID.

**Controller (`.../distributed/coordinator.py`, `admm.py`, `pdlp_mlu.py`, `partial_barrier.py`)** — bias `B[w,e]`, utilization `X`, over-relaxed target `V`, closed-form water-filling projection (route ceiling / admit ceiling), pressure `t=ρ(V−z)`, dual identity `u=u0+αX+(1−α)z0−z`, `ρ·u`-preserving retune, and the cached partial barrier (seen/fresh/ages/quorum/max_lag) with checkpoint snapshot/restore.

**Verification performed** (all green): public `check.py`; an independent spec-derived verifier replaying discrete state and checking every worker/controller certificate and state identity; ~700 randomized requests; 10 hand-computed scenario chains; 110 illegal/legal validation cases including restore-aware path patches; brute-force optimality checks of the projection (incl. negative `z`); 5600+ worker QPs with worst certificate error 1.4e-5 of tolerance; magnitude extremes; and max-size 384-event requests in 0.4 s under the real `check_worker` sandbox.
